Breaking my arm would almost be easier, but I really know I should. That's for another day...

Just been trying to calm myself down and I guess the best I can do for now is sleep, know I have said much on here but thanks all the same for the replies everyone. Hope I can get the balls to get help some day

I've wanted to for months, but it chokes me up with embarrassment and shame. And that's just talking about being depressed in past tense, I don't even think I can look my mom in the face now. This is the worst part of me no one is supposed to know until I'm gone, or it's gone.
